# tty

Check whether standard input is definitely redirected on POSIX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/tty -s
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--silent`, `--quiet` | Report status without writing a name. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

A regular file, directory, pipe, socket or block device produces not a tty and status 1. Character devices require a terminal ioctl, and Windows descriptor queries require a public console API; these cases return status 2.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
